selection_filter.description: 100 entries stratified by category from the union of original full-reference failures and unscored outputs in the 1,113-image local-speed and corrected-cloud evaluation.
selection_filter.split_method: Within-category exact-image-hash groups; select evaluation hashes by SHA-256 rank of point4-cloud-eval-v1:<image_sha256>, rounded to 20% per category with at least one evaluation hash when a category has two or more; all duplicate hashes remain in one split.

method.labels: Evaluation-v4 OCR reference scores computed offline after inference.
method.completeness: Initial OCR attempt is scored against both >=80% tolerant word coverage and the full-reference pass.
method.comparison: Candidate and incumbent are compared by tolerant matched-word counts; this does not score visual fidelity or geometry.
method.probabilities: Only native provider-reported confidence and per-option probabilities are summarized; absent values stay absent.
method.limitations: A held-out split within a difficulty-selected development subset is not an independent benchmark. No confidence threshold or production policy is fitted or changed.
